name: Echo
description: Takes what was said on a customer call and lays it out as slides — findings, agreed next steps, planned initiatives, or the full set. Delivers into Figma or Google Slides, so a team standardised on another deck tool would need to export.

official.title: Echo by Krista
official.description: Turns a customer call into slides from customer context. What we heard, next steps, project initiatives, or all of the above. Works with Figma or Google...
